newsitem.title: FRANCE: One dead in French gypsy baptism shooting.
newsitem.headline: One dead in French gypsy baptism shooting.

text.p: One man was killed and two others wounded when hooded gunmen opened fire in a hall where gypsies were holding a party to celebrate a baptism, police said on Sunday.
Between 30 and 40 people were present when the four gunmen broke into the hall at about 1.00 a.m. (2300 GMT) and started shooting.
Most of those present had fled when police arrived on the scene. Investigators said later they were following several leads.
